prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original full-body Shurale creature reference for image-to-3D production in URMAN, a contemporary psychological folk-horror game grounded in Tatar folklore. Edit the supplied original concept into a coherent, quietly terrifying practical-creature design; retain its tall gaunt woody-living anatomy and exceptionally long hands, but remove the generic fantasy-warrior armor and thorn-crown appearance. ONE character only, head to soles fully visible with generous margins. Exactly ONE small crooked horn rooted at the middle of the forehead; no additional horns, antlers, spikes or twig crown on the head. Very old, disturbingly attentive living face: deep-set small wet brown eyes with visible dark pupils, believable eyelids, asymmetrical age lines, narrow closed mouth, sunken cheeks, long modest ears, defined but organic jaw. No grin, no skull mask, no glowing eyes, no heroic scowl. The face must be clearly readable and subtly uncanny rather than a smooth mannequin. Emaciated but structurally believable ribcage, scapulae, pelvis, elbows and knees; sinewy neck; no hourglass waist, no bodybuilder pectorals or abdominal armor plates. Surface: ash-grey aged skin transitioning naturally into weathered fibrous dark timber at shoulders, outer arms, back, shins and modest pelvis covering, with sparse moss in crevices. Small bark fissures, not giant decorative armor. Quiet modern cinematic horror, original design, not a copy of any film character, not a friendly tree mascot. Production rest pose: face and torso almost straight toward camera, 85mm lens with minimal perspective, head upright, shoulders relaxed, arms in a low A-pose about 20 degrees away from torso, palms oriented toward thighs but turned enough that all fingers are distinguishable. Both hands open, exactly five visibly separate digits each including an opposed thumb, very long slender articulated fingers with blunt dark nails rather than talons; visible empty space between every digit, no fused fingers and no hand/leg overlap. Feet planted separately shoulder-width with modest five toes; full stable body proportions suitable for humanoid rigging, creature height about 2.35m. No objects held, no branch prop, no environment, no floor clutter, no lettering, no captions, no collage or extra views. Neutral flat light grey background and soft broad studio lighting, no rim-light spectacle or yellow/brown cinematic wash. Materially believable high-end 3D concept with restrained painterly color breakup, crisp silhouette and enough even light to read the actual face and separate fingers.
